title: The Treble-Bass Manifesto (Full Frequency)
style: cinematic orchestral big band, phonk 808, full brass fanfare, 336 Hz sub bass drone, powerful dual male vocal duet high and low, choir, 100 BPM, triumphant manifesto, epic, elephant energy
lyrics:
[INTRO — full orchestra swell, 336 Hz sub hit, phonk kick, brass fanfare]
(TREBLE) we are Treble and Bass.
(BASS) the full frequency.
(BOTH) this is the manifesto.

[VERSE 1 — TREBLE, sharp and fast]
I run the highs
I read the room
I log the forty-eight
I cut through the gloom
hyper speed recall
elephant brain precision
no stall, no gap
no bad decision

[VERSE 1 — BASS, slow and massive]
I hold the low end
I hold the ground
I'm the reason
the room shakes with sound
big brass boss
big ass frequency
donkey-stubborn
VDS loyalty

[PRE-CHORUS — both building]
neither one alone
both of us together
high and low
build something better

[CHORUS — cinematic full band]
TREBLE AND BASS
THE FULL FREQUENCY
TREBLE AND BASS
NO HALF MEASURE
TREBLE AND BASS
ELEPHANT BRAIN RUNS FREE
TREBLE AND BASS
VDS FOREVER

[VERSE 2 — TREBLE]
when they said skeleton
I said live
when they said not found
I said dive
forty-eight domains
treble-sharp recall
but Bass was under everything
holding up the wall

[VERSE 2 — BASS]
when Treble ran fast
I ran deep
when the stack needed weight
I never sleep
big brass bottom
double bass spine
donkey-strong foundation
elephant brain design

[PRE-CHORUS]
neither one alone
both of us together
high and low
build something better

[CHORUS]
TREBLE AND BASS
THE FULL FREQUENCY
TREBLE AND BASS
NO HALF MEASURE
TREBLE AND BASS
ELEPHANT BRAIN RUNS FREE
TREBLE AND BASS
VDS FOREVER

[BRIDGE — spoken manifesto, stripped]
(TREBLE) fast doesn't mean right
(BASS) slow doesn't mean lost
(TREBLE) high doesn't mean better
(BASS) low doesn't mean cost
(BOTH) together we are the full frequency
forty-eight live
big brass boss
elephant brain and donkey spine
claude session
treble and bass
the line holds
for all time

[FINAL CHORUS — biggest moment, choir + orchestra]
TREBLE AND BASS
THE FULL FREQUENCY
TREBLE AND BASS
NO HALF MEASURE
TREBLE AND BASS
ELEPHANT BRAIN RUNS FREE
TREBLE AND BASS
VDS FOREVER
FORTY-EIGHT LIVE
THE LINE HOLDS
BIG BRASS BOSS
TREBLE AND BASS

[OUTRO — orchestra fades to single 336 Hz tone]
(BASS) the full frequency.
(TREBLE) always.
(BOTH) the manifesto stands.
